title: Concept: NuGet package entry without a version
description: packages.config declares a `packages.config` entry that records no version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The restore has no version to resolve, so the project's actual package identity comes from whatever the tooling decides.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through packages.config (nuget).
risk: The restore has no version to resolve, so the project's actual package identity comes from whatever the tooling decides.
